offering_description.value: Regulated electric and natural gas utility serving homes, businesses and industrial customers in the Pacific Northwest and Alaska. It generates and buys power, including from its hydroelectric dams, and delivers electricity and gas over its own networks.

primary_services.value: electric and gas delivery; power transmission; utility metering and connection

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential electricity and natural gas customers; B2B: commercial, industrial and agricultural customers, and wholesale power buyers

end_markets.value: residential energy; commercial buildings; manufacturing; agriculture; forest products

revenue_model.value: product sales: electricity and natural gas sold to customers under regulated tariffs; transaction or usage fees: delivery charges based on metered energy use; other: wholesale power sales and purchases on energy markets
revenue_model.category: product sales; transaction or usage fees; other

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs hydroelectric, gas-fired generation, transmission and distribution networks; service provider: delivers and sells electricity and gas to end customers under utility regulation

geography_served.value: US regional: Washington, Idaho, Oregon and Alaska (Juneau)

specialization.value: related lines: electric utility service and natural gas utility service, sharing networks and customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility service billed directly to residential, commercial and industrial customers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: utility rates and operations set by state utility commissions, the Alaska RCA and FERC, federal energy and reliability rules apply
